Budew

Grass Poison

Sinnoh · Generation 4 · Baby Pokémon

Budew is a Grass/Poison-type Bud Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4), and is classed as a Baby Pokémon. It stands 0.2 m tall and weighs 1.2 kg. It evolves into Roselia. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (70), with a base stat total of 280.
